0022600211.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 0-4 on the road, 15th in the East) take a six-game losing streak into their 11th game of the 2026-27 season, while the New York Knicks (5-4, 3rd in the Atlantic, 5th in the East) are riding a three-game winning streak. Bucks guard Tyler Herro (bruise, 21.4 points and 30.7 minutes per game) and Gary Trent Jr. (illness, 3.0 points and 6.3 minutes per game) are both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Knicks forward Josh Hart (ankle) is also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bucks lost 1-2 to the Knicks in the 2025-26 season, including a 127-98 loss in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
